name: ADSI-Cache File Creation By Uncommon Tool
description: Detects the creation of an "Active Directory Schema Cache File" (.sch) file by an uncommon tool.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Other legimate tools, which do ADSI (LDAP) operations, e.g. any remoting activity by MMC, Powershell, Windows etc.
query: (file.path:*\\Local\\Microsoft\\Windows\\SchCache\\* AND file.path:*.sch) AND (NOT (((process.executable:(*\:\\Program\ Files\\Cylance\\Desktop\\CylanceSvc.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\CCM\\CcmExec.exe OR *\:\\windows\\system32\\dllhost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\system32\\dsac.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\system32\\efsui.exe OR *\:\\windows\\system32\\mmc.exe OR *\:\\windows\\system32\\svchost.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\:\\windows\\system32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe)) OR (process.executable:(*\:\\Windows\\ccmsetup\\autoupgrade\\ccmsetup* OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel\ Agent*))) OR ((process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\* AND process.executable:*\\Microsoft\ Office*) AND process.executable:*\\OUTLOOK.EXE))) AND (NOT (process.executable:(*\\LANDesk\\LDCLient\\ldapwhoami.exe OR *\:\\Program\ Files\\Citrix\\Receiver\ StoreFront\\Services\\DefaultDomainServices\\Citrix.DeliveryServices.DomainServices.ServiceHost.exe)))
